methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Sharp uniform exponent cutoff j<=2 for at most four nonzero ternary dyadic rank-one frames summing to I3 and at most five summing to 2I3; sharp denominator and term-limit fixtures and a finite-domain reduction of short-word determinant/subset screens.
scope_change_reason: The unrestricted nine-call endpoint floor is already proved in PR1628. This contribution proves a separate geometric restriction on short matrix decompositions, prompted by PR1679, without auditing predecessor results or claiming a new endpoint floor.
bottleneck_link: An infinite dyadic alphabet collapses to half/quarter frames under determinant and target-subset necessary screens for the specified short-word model. This is a scoped BIT screening side result, not a new supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified denominator cutoff with sharpness fixtures; package the proof and checker without extending to larger term counts or other dimensions.
evidence: PROOF.md uniform proof; verify.py generated hash-bound receipt, exact gap/profile/numerator checks, sharpness fixtures and rejection controls.
